newsitem.title: USA: American Wagering signs 3 MegaSports deals.
newsitem.headline: American Wagering signs 3 MegaSports deals.

text.p: American Wagering Inc Thursday said three casinos signed contracts to join the MegaSports network following approval from the Nevada Gaming Commission.
The three casinos are The Aladdin Hotel and Casino, Arizona Charlie's Casino and the Fiesta Casino. Financial terms were undisclosed.
MegaSports, a pari-mutuel system for betting on sports events, is being sold by American Wagering Inc and International Game Technology.
"There's a feeling of momentum; we are optimistic that the MegaSports network will continue to grow," Vic Salerno, chief executive officer of American Wagering, said in a statement.
